Example US International Award

The Example Trust supports school students who want to go on to university.

Eligibility

This award is open to international students only.

Applicants must hold an offer to study at a university in the United States.

Applicants must submit a letter from their school principal.

Benefits

Selected students receive USD 5,000 a year.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your documents before the closing date. Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the selection panel, and the results are announced on this page.
